id.description: R<pack>-<section>-<SLUG>, e.g. R15-2-ONE_TEST. Open rulings keep their source code, e.g. R15-A.

pack.description: Human name of the source document, e.g. 'Pack Fifteen' or 'Moto Reversion Ledger'.

pack_number.description: 1-19 for numbered packs, null for standalone amendments. Drives precedence ordering.

section.description: Section locus as printed in the source, e.g. '§4', 'PART II.3', 'AMENDMENT THIRTEEN'.

summary.description: One sentence, your words. What a writer must do or not do.

verbatim.description: Exact text from the source. Whitespace-normalised. Checked by validate.py.

supersedes.description: Rule IDs this kills. Only when the source says so in quotable words.

verification.description: Check numbers or wotr_verify.sh flags this rule is enforced by, e.g. 'check-18', '--combat'.

ratified.description: Date or session note if the source states Isaac ruled on it. Null if unstated.
